svg.title: Synaap
svg.desc: A pulse opens a portrait scanner. Its pieces scatter and resolve into the outlines of a figure, birds and a waterfront skyline. Their pink and violet sunset develops behind Synaap’s wordmark.
svg.metadata: Sunset artwork and avatar supplied with Synaap/Codex-Animated: https://github.com/Synaap/Codex-Animated . Animation inspiration credited by the launcher: https://github.com/panding999/codex-startup-animation/tree/c743c2b5eceaa7be9dc511d23a1a77f7c4ce6248 .
